title: Newmark Arranges $43 Million Financing for Franklin Avenue Plaza, a Class A Office Complex in Garden City, NY
summary: Newmark has arranged a $43 million refinancing on behalf of Capstone Equities for Franklin Avenue Plaza, a 488,835-square-foot office complex in Garden City, New York.
